integrity: Proof is self-contained after clearly cited classical matroid shellability and finite-group orbit fundamental-group theorems; no independent validation or novelty certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary geometric quotient by the Singer cyclic group is treated. Homology and fundamental group are classified; higher homotopy and the cohomology ring are not. Finite verifier tests q=2,3,4,5 only. Prior equivalence in unindexed sources remains possible.
title: Singer-cycle orbit spaces of projective-plane matroid complexes: a threefold stabilizer dichotomy
